build.title: Expenses port: bring Expenses into AmberX-AXF as its own app

said.text: I want to port expenses to AmberX. It's in another repo. ... It should stay its own app in the same repo. ... Make sure it's the right one, the one that has the most entries in it.

steps.text: s0 Compare MossesX/Expense vs MossesX/Expenses (commits, files, features, data); confirm the right one
s1 Import Expense into apps/expenses keeping git history (subtree merge)
s2 Put it on the framework: manifest, bake, axHub look, shared assets, help, banner, Molly frame + nav
s3 Deploy from AXF: CI build, VPS update cron with lock, same /data volume, safe cutover + one-command rollback
s4 API/MCP/CLI for expenses: list/add/edit entries, accounts, totals, export
s5 Tests/type-check, screenshots to UI Review, report, THREADS, PR

tests.name: npx tsx scripts/expenses-api.test.mts: 17 checks. npx tsx scripts/expenses-grid.test.mts: 7 checks (grid save merges by id). They cover auth, add, edit, filters, totals, accounts, CSV, that the app's kv document shape is kept, and the daily backup.
project.mjs validate --all, check-theme, check-conform, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-xlayout, help-coverage --check and check-plugin-pages all pass.
plugins.mjs --check, tracker.mjs --check and shared-assets.mjs check fail the same way on main without this branch, so this build didn't cause them.

Screenshots: phone and desktop of the live sign-in, served by the new container. They are in UI Review → Screenshots, group expenses-port - Nov 4 6:33 AM. Molly's new nav item reaches molly.amberxai.com when this PR merges.

open: The look is not on the AXF theme engines yet. The app still draws with its vendored `@axf/core` 0.0.25 look (the earlier studio line), not the AXF engines or axHub's appearance@1. A full re-theme of about 90 UI files is its own build. Until then:
its 923 theme findings are held to a shrink-only baseline in `framework/spec/conform-baseline.json` (`check-theme.mjs` FROZEN entry), so CI stays green and the count can only go down;
it is not in `shared-assets.json`, has no baked `src/axf` and no AXF help or banner.

Last save wins between the grid and the API: fixed (Nov 4 2026, build app-voice-commands). The grid's save now merges by entry id: the tab sends the ids it has seen (`known`), the route keeps every entry it never saw (added by the API, CLI, MCP or a voice command) and answers with them so the tab takes them in; an id the tab knew and dropped is a delete; `replace: true` (Load a snapshot) and bodies without `known` replace the list as before. `npx tsx scripts/expenses-grid.test.mts` (7 checks). T
The old deploy paths still exist.

`~/hub/deploy/expense.sh` (on a push to MossesX/Expense) and studioX's deploy both run `docker compose up --build` for the same container name. Either would now fail on the name clash and leave the AXF container running.
Nobody pushes to MossesX/Expense any more. Archive it only when Brett says so.
The console's MCP tools go live with the console's next deploy after merge.
The old repo's `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` came along inside `apps/expenses/.github`. GitHub never runs workflows outside the repo root, so it is inert.
